data.name: Amiraah
data.gender_notes: Amiraah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘amr’ meaning ‘command’, ‘order’ or ‘rule’. The name Amiraah conveys the idea of a powerful and regal figure. In Islamic tradition, it is often given to girls born into royal families or those destined for great leadership roles. The name Amiraah carries the meaning “Princess, Ruler, Commander” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amiraah usually hope their child will grow to embody princess, ruler, commander and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of authority and guidance, bestowed upon those entrusted with leadership roles.
data.etymology: Amiraah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Princess, Ruler, Commander.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amiraah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
